paragraphs: Live (2026-10-06): the Safe build at instant-wallet-b2jn.vercel.app — docs/SAFE-APP.md. 14 networks (2026-10-08): which ones, why, and how the relay gets gas on each — docs/NETWORKS.md. Claim cards (2026-10-08): money on a QR / NFC tag / link, claimed into a new wallet — docs/CLAIM.md. The plan (2026-10-05): docs/PLAN.md — Instant Wallet becomes a Gnosis Safe front end: burner passkey → MetaMask → sharded paper seed → wedgie, progressive decentralization. The older v3 plan (docs/V3.md, our own contract) is shelved. v3 in progress (2026-10): passkey hot key + wedgie cold key. Plan: docs/V3.md.…

Your money, instantly. A passkey smart-contract wallet (Face ID / Touch ID, no seed phrase, no gas) that you can harden with a $35 hardware signer you build yourself from three off-the-shelf parts. One account, many P-256 keys, tiered by trust. Optional AI on top, bring your own model.

It is the child of two projects: progressive-self-custody (passkeys + facilitator-paid gas) and picowallet (a Pico 2 W + ATECC608 hardware wallet with a green SIGN button). Both signers speak P-256, so one contract verifies both.
features: Day 1: Face ID makes a key. The address exists before any deposit. Send with a face scan.
Later: build the device, scan its screen, done. It becomes the owner; Face ID keeps a daily
Lost phone: the device adds a new one. Lost both: the recovery address adds a key after a delay.
AI: "send $20 to atg.eth", "what did I spend this week" — turns into the same proposal card
